newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in after-hours trade on Friday after the yen's decline against the dollar stimulated short-covering in the afternoon session, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 0.2 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark June was off 0.2 yen at 147.5 yen. Volume was 4,014 lots.
"Market sentiment improved slightly on technicals. But activity remained lacklustre amid a dearth of fresh incentives," one trader said.
